game.title: Ashfall
game.subtitle: Kharos IV — one year after the fall

hud.controlsHint: {move} move · {lmb}/{rmb} attack · 1–4 skills · {dodge} dodge · {potion} potion · {inv} inventory · {skills} skills · {pickup} pick up · {debug} debug
hud.respawnHint: Press {key} or click to rise again

combat.overheat: Overheating! Spend Heat to cool down

hydraulic_strike.name: Hydraulic Strike
hydraulic_strike.desc: Swing your hydraulic fist in a wide arc. Above 70 Heat, sets enemies on fire.

seismic_shock.name: Seismic Shock
seismic_shock.desc: Slam the ground, knocking enemies back and making them Vulnerable.

rocket_leap.name: Rocket Leap
rocket_leap.desc: Boost into the air and crash down, stunning enemies where you land.

energy_shield.name: Energy Shield
energy_shield.desc: Project a barrier worth 35% of your life and shake off stuns and slows.

piston_jab.name: Piston Jab
piston_jab.desc: A fast, narrow jab that briefly makes enemies Vulnerable. Generates Heat.

furnace_cleave.name: Furnace Cleave
furnace_cleave.desc: A wide superheated cleave that sets enemies on fire.

coolant_flush.name: Coolant Flush
coolant_flush.desc: Vent 40 Heat into coolant: heal 18% of your life and gain a small barrier.

magnetic_pull.name: Magnetic Pull
magnetic_pull.desc: A magnetic burst that drags nearby enemies to you and stuns them briefly.

heat_vent.name: Heat Vent
heat_vent.desc: Release all stored Heat as a wave of fire. The more Heat, the more damage (requires 20 Heat).

orbital_strike.name: Orbital Strike
orbital_strike.desc: Call down an orbital strike at the cursor. After a short warning it deals massive damage, stuns and makes enemies Vulnerable.

items.hint: Right-click: equip · Shift+click: salvage · Click a crystal, then an item: socket

tree.title: Skills
tree.resetConfirm: Refund all skill points for {gold} gold?
tree.barHint: Click an action bar slot, then a learned skill to assign it. Right-click a slot to clear it.
tree.chooseOne: Choose one of the two modifiers.
tree.onlyOneKey: You can only have one Key Passive.
tree.assignHint: Select an action bar slot first to assign this skill.

searing.name: Searing Strike
searing.desc: Hydraulic Strike always sets enemies on fire.

crushing.name: Crushing Strike
crushing.desc: Hydraulic Strike deals +40% damage to Stunned and to Vulnerable enemies.

rapid.name: Rapid Jab
rapid.desc: Piston Jab winds up 40% faster and generates 3 more Heat.

breaching.name: Breaching Jab
breaching.desc: Piston Jab deals x50% damage to Vulnerable enemies.

pull.name: Seismic Pull
pull.desc: Seismic Shock pulls enemies in instead of pushing them away.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.desc: Seismic Shock leaves a burning fissure for 3 seconds.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.desc: Furnace Cleave deals +50% damage to Burning enemies.

molten.name: Molten Whirl
molten.desc: Furnace Cleave hits all around you, but deals 15% less damage.

reactive.name: Reactive Plating
reactive.desc: While you have a barrier, deal +15% damage.

restoring.name: Restoring Field
restoring.desc: Energy Shield also heals 12% of your life.

crater.name: Impact Crater
crater.desc: Rocket Leap leaves a burning crater for 4 seconds.

polarity.name: Polarity
polarity.desc: Magnetic Pull makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

crushing_force.name: Crushing Force
crushing_force.desc: +6% damage to Vulnerable enemies per rank.

heat_tolerance.name: Heat Tolerance
heat_tolerance.desc: You can stay at max Heat 0.5 seconds longer before overheating, per rank.

reactor_core.name: Reactor Core
reactor_core.desc: While Heat is at least 70%, deal x25% damage. You overheat 0.5 seconds sooner.

bulwark_protocol.name: Bulwark Protocol
bulwark_protocol.desc: While you have a barrier, deal x20% damage. Barriers are 30% stronger.

shockwave_engine.name: Shockwave Engine
shockwave_engine.desc: Vulnerable enemies take x30% damage from you.

fissure.name: Fissuring
fissure.desc: Seismic Shock leaves a burning fissure that deals {value} of weapon damage per second for 3 seconds.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.desc: Hydraulic Strike and Piston Jab generate {value} more Heat.

echo.name: Echoing
echo.desc: Seismic Shock has {value} larger radius and deals {value} more damage.

molten_fists.name: Molten
molten_fists.desc: Hydraulic Strike always sets enemies on fire, dealing {value} of weapon damage over 3 seconds.

brutality.name: Brutal
brutality.desc: Deal x{value} damage to Stunned enemies.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: While you have a barrier, deal x{value} damage.

wrecking_ball.name: Wrecking
wrecking_ball.desc: Rocket Leap has {value} larger landing radius and deals {value} more landing damage.

vulnerability_matrix.name: Exposing
vulnerability_matrix.desc: Deal x{value} damage to Vulnerable enemies.

lifeblood.name: Lifeblood
lifeblood.desc: Restore {value} life whenever an enemy dies.

governors_crucible.name: Governor's Crucible
governors_crucible.effect: Seismic Shock costs no Heat, but has a 3.5 second cooldown.
governors_crucible.flavor: The governor wore it to the very end. It held. He didn't.

ashwalker_treads.name: Ashwalker Treads
ashwalker_treads.effect: Rocket Leap cooldown −60% and landing damage +60%, but it costs 25 Heat and generates none.

fist_of_kharos.name: Fist of Kharos
fist_of_kharos.effect: Hydraulic Strike becomes a full spin that hits all around you, with 20% less damage.
fist_of_kharos.flavor: Forged from the first drill bit that touched the Lumen.

heart_of_lumen.name: Heart of Lumen
heart_of_lumen.effect: Deal x35% damage. Overheating no longer damages you.
heart_of_lumen.flavor: It beats. It is not yours.
